<?php
class AllocationBase233 { public $value = 0; public function __construct($value,$ignored) { $this->value = $value; echo self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return 99; } }
class AllocationScope233 extends AllocationBase233 { public static function launch() { global $owner; $a = $owner->MiSsInG(new self(1,0)); $b = $owner->MiSsInG(new parent(2,0)); $c = $owner->MiSsInG(first:new static(3,0)); echo ($a->saved[0] instanceof AllocationScope233 && $a->saved[0]->value === 1 && $b->saved[0] instanceof AllocationBase233 && $b->saved[0]->value === 2 && $c->saved["first"] instanceof AllocationChild233 && $c->saved["first"]->value === 3) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; } } class AllocationChild233 extends AllocationScope233 {}
class ScopeMagic233 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} }; } }
$owner = new ScopeMagic233; AllocationChild233::launch(); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class EmptyBase233 {} class EmptyScope233 extends EmptyBase233 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(new self,new parent); } public static function called() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(first:new static,later:null); } } class EmptyChild233 extends EmptyScope233 {}
class EmptyMagic233 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} }; } }
$owner = new EmptyMagic233; $a = EmptyChild233::launch(); $b = EmptyChild233::called(); echo ($a->saved[0] instanceof EmptyScope233 && $a->saved[1] instanceof EmptyBase233 && $b->saved["first"] instanceof EmptyChild233 && $b->saved["later"] === null) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;";

<?php
function shift233() { global $argument,$owner; $argument = new New233; $owner = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return null; }
class Old233 { public $value = 7; public function __destruct() { echo "OLD;"; } } class New233 { public $value = 99; public function __destruct() { echo "NEW;"; } }
class PacketBase233 { public $saved = 0; public function __construct($saved,$ignored) { $this->saved = $saved->value; echo "CTOR;"; return 7; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketScope233 extends PacketBase233 { public static function launch() { global $argument,$owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(new self($argument,shift233()),null); } } class PacketChild233 extends PacketScope233 {}
class Base233 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { global $argument; $argument = null; echo "HANDLER;"; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } } class Derived233 extends Base233 {}
$argument = new Old233; $owner = new Derived233; $child = PacketChild233::launch(); echo "RETURN;"; echo ($child->saved[0] instanceof PacketScope233 && $child->saved[0]->saved === 7) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class FailedBase233 { public function __construct($value) { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "CTOR;"; throw new Exception("stop"); } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class FailedScope233 extends FailedBase233 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(new static(1),later233()); } } class FailedChild233 extends FailedScope233 {}
function later233() { echo "LATER;"; return null; } class FailedMagic233 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new FailedMagic233; $result = 0; try { $result = FailedChild233::launch(); } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CATCH;"; } echo $result === 0 ? "HELD;" : "BAD;";
